I am currently a mathematics PhD student working under [Amie Wilkinson](https://www.math.uchicago.edu/~wilkinso/) at the University of Chicago ([Chicago, IL](/city-streets/city.html?slug=chicago)). Previously, I obtained my BS/MS degree in mathematics at Carnegie Mellon University ([Pittsburgh, PA](/city-streets/city.html?slug=pittsburgh)). Broadly, I am interested in most things related to dynamical systems or analysis. Currently, I am working in smooth ergodic theory, particularly the dimension theory of random diffeomorphisms. In the past, I have also thought about harmonic analysis, descriptive set theory, and function spaces in PDE.

This site collects my [papers & reports](papers/index.qmd) and some [projects](projects/index.qmd) for fun.

## Recently

- **[City Streets](/city-streets/)** — an interactive atlas that treats each city's streets as a probability measure on $\mathbb{RP}^2$, comparing 84 world cities by orientation, hilliness, and walkability.
